# Draft technical charter — not adopted

Project name: MessageBench, subject to foundation naming checks.

Mission: develop reusable adapter-neutral declared preservation tests for financial-message file pairs and honest, reproducible coverage evidence.

Scope: version-specific extraction, typed declarative contracts, synthetic edge cases, deterministic privacy-conscious reports and file-handoff integrations. Excluded: payment rails, settlement, hosted services, proprietary scheme authority, certification and live institution probing.

Governance proposal: a Technical Steering Committee of actual approved maintainers; public issue/PR decisions; documented conflicts and review requirements; consensus followed by a recorded vote under the foundation's approved charter. Initial membership remains a human designation, not a generated list.

Contributions: apply FINOS-required contributor/IP process; original contribution rights retained and checked; no blanket relicensing of third-party XSDs. Maintainers use review, CI and semantic versioning. Security disclosures remain private until coordinated disclosure.

Release process: RC scope disclosed; genuine independent technical/rights review and owner approval precede formal release. OIDC provenance authenticates a build workflow, not a correctness endorsement.

Transfer and trademark decisions require the entity's legal signatory. This draft confers no FINOS affiliation, CLA signature, sponsor commitment or governing authority.
